# TOON encode fixtures

Copied unchanged from the TOON specification's conformance fixtures, <https://github.com/toon-format/spec>, `tests/fixtures/encode/`,
at commit `eee00a23c2bdd0d4ae3324529fbbb7c3d3fd1359` (spec 4.3, fixtures version 4.0), under the MIT licence (`LICENSES/MIT.txt`).
`server/tests/test_toon_out_fixtures.py` runs every case within the scope of Lampway's small encoder against
`lampway_server.compute.toon_out` (audit F9, 2026-10-06).
